name: Bienville Parish, Louisiana (United States)
description: Yellow field within a dark red border, charged with an outline map of the parish in red bearing BIENVILLE PARISH, with a pine tree, a deer, a watermelon and a logo in the corners, the motto Progressing with Pride above and State of Louisiana below.
